entries.title: Show HN: YouTube banned adblockers so I built an extension to skip their ads
entries.author: rKarpinski
entries.current_title: Show HN: YouTube banned adblockers so I built an extension to skip their ads
entries.excerpt: Hi HN! Since Youtube no longer allows AdBlockers, I built my own extension to get around their video ads. If there is an ad it temporarily manipulates the video; Mutes the volume, sets speed to 10x, and skips it if there is a button. Chrome Webstore link: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ad-accelerator/gpboiedfklodfhngobidfjecdpmccehg?hl=en Code: https://github.com/rkk3/ad-accelerator
entries.guide_zh: YouTube 限制广告拦截后，作者用扩展静音、加速并跳过广告。

entries.title: Show HN: Dalle-3 and GPT4-Vision feedback loop
entries.author: z991
entries.current_title: Show HN: A Dalle-3 and GPT4-Vision feedback loop
entries.excerpt: I used to enjoy Translation Party, and over the weekend I realized that we can build the same feedback loop with DALLE-3 and GPT4-Vision. Start with a text prompt, let DALLE-3 generate an image, then GPT-4 Vision turns that image back into a text prompt, DALLE-3 creates another image, and so on. entries.guide_zh: 让 DALL·E 3 画图、GPT-4 Vision 描述，再循环生成，观察图文如何逐步变化。

entries.title: Show HN: New visual language for teaching kids to code
entries.author: csmeyer
entries.current_title: Show HN: New visual language for teaching kids to code
entries.excerpt: Pickcode is a new language and editor for getting kids started with coding. The code editing experience is totally structured, where you select choices from menus rather than typing. I made Pickcode after experiences teaching kids both block coding (Scratch, App Inventor) and Python. To me, block coding is too far removed from regular coding for kids to make the connection. Pickcode provides a much clearer transition path for students to Python/JS/Java. Our target market is m
entries.guide_zh: Pickcode 用菜单选择替代自由输入，为孩子提供结构化编程语言与编辑器。

entries.title: Show HN: I saw this mind-blowing experiment, so I made a simple version of it
entries.author: momciloo
entries.current_title: Show HN: I saw this mind-blowing experiment, so I made a simple version of it
entries.excerpt: Two browser windows (acting as socket clients) communicate their: - Screen dimensions - (screen.width, screen.height) - Window dimensions - (window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight) - Window X/Y position - (window.screenX, window.screenY) ...or whichever calculation works best for you. entries.guide_zh: 让两个浏览器窗口交换尺寸与位置，作者重现跨窗口互动实验。
